description:
Showing up for someone takes a year of quiet attention. Kudao holds that attention for you, one person at a time.

Every birthday, anniversary, wedding and remembrance lives in one warm place, with a live countdown so nothing sneaks up on you. Check the home grid or glance at the widget on your Home Screen.

Import birthdays straight from your contacts, with the option to hide the age for anyone who'd rather keep that private. Then start a quiet diary for each person: small things you notice through the year, tagged as you go.

When the date approaches, those notes become genuinely personal gift ideas, opening an Amazon search or a map of nearby shops so you're not starting from a blank page. If words don't come easily, Kudao can draft a greeting in your chosen tone — but it never sends anything on its own. The final tap is always yours.

Planning a party? Share it, along with a photo gallery, by inviting someone with a link and choosing exactly what they can see or do. No feeds, no likes, no comments — just the people who matter, looking at the same plan.

Remembrance profiles are treated differently on purpose. No ads, no suggestions, no nudging — just a quiet, respectful space that stays as calm as it should be.

Birthdays and remembrances are free, forever. Premium unlocks wedding and other event profiles and removes ads, for 4.99 EUR a month or 29.99 EUR a year.

Once an event passes, it's archived automatically into a searchable library, available in Italian, English, French and Spanish.

Kudao doesn't ask for much. Just a year of small attention, held somewhere safe until it matters.

Download Kudao and start paying attention, one person at a time.
